mechanism_narrative: A lower Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signal a recession with aggressive monetary easing, prompting market optimism for policy support and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400.0) signal a collapsing residential sector, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: Higher Consumer Price Index levels (CPIAUCSL > 300.0) indicate elevated inflation, increasing expectations of monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales (RSAFS < 690000.0) reflect subdued consumer spending, signaling reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is below 690000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1400.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicate a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession, rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals worsening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% and GDPC1 growth is negative.
